about_short_description.short_description: Alchemy is a developer platform that helps companies to build reliable decentralized applications.

product.name: Cortex
product.description: An intelligent blockchain infrastructure engine that routes and processes onchain requests across globally distributed infrastructure for scalable applications.

product.name: RPC API
product.description: A cloud API for querying blockchain nodes, reading onchain state, and submitting transactions across more than 100 supported blockchains.

product.name: Data APIs
product.description: API services for retrieving blockchain data such as token prices, balances, NFTs, portfolio information, and transaction history.

product.name: Gas Manager API
product.description: A transaction-sponsorship service that lets applications pay users’ blockchain gas fees and support gasless transaction experiences.

product.name: Rollups
product.description: Infrastructure and services for launching and operating custom blockchain networks and rollups.

product.name: Webhooks
product.description: A webhook service that delivers onchain event notifications to applications as blockchain activity occurs.
